capabilities: : Organize notes into a page tree
: Drag and drop pages to reorder
: Add child pages to existing pages
extras: Supports Obsidian on Windows, macOS, and iOS.
intentEvidence: PageTree organizes Obsidian notes into a page tree, where every page can contain both text and child pages.
problem: Traditional folder-based organization can be limiting for representing complex, nested relationships between notes.
summary: PageTree organizes Obsidian notes into a hierarchical page tree structure, allowing pages to contain both content and child pages.
